department_name: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs and BCs and Antyodaya
description_raw: Social security monthly financial allowance provided to senior citizens of Haryana who lack sufficient personal income sources.
benefits_raw: Monthly financial pension of ₹3,000 disbursed directly into the beneficiary bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility_criteria_raw: Permanent resident/domicile of Haryana; minimum age 60 years or above; combined annual family income of husband and wife not exceeding ₹3,00,000 as verified in Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP); not receiving any other government pension.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Senior Citizens, Elderly men and women (60+)
application_process_raw: Apply online through Antyodaya Saral portal (saralharyana.gov.in) or visit nearest Citizen Service Centre (CSC) / Antyodaya Kendra. Verification is conducted via Parivar Pehchan Patra.
required_documents_raw: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) Family ID, Proof of Age (Voter ID/Birth Certificate/Matric Certificate), Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Passbook, Haryana Domicile Certificate.

department_name: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs and BCs and Antyodaya
description_raw: Financial security pension granted to differently-abled residents of Haryana to assist them in meeting day-to-day sustenance requirements.
benefits_raw: Monthly disability allowance of ₹3,000 transferred directly to beneficiary bank account via DBT.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Resident of Haryana; age 18 years or older; permanent disability of 60% or higher certified by authorized Government Medical Board / Civil Surgeon; annual family income not exceeding ₹3,00,000 in PPP.
application_process_raw: Apply online on Antyodaya Saral portal (saralharyana.gov.in) or submit application form at District Social Welfare Office / CSC.
required_documents_raw: Disability Certificate issued by Civil Surgeon/Medical Board, Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) ID, Aadhaar Card, Haryana Residence Certificate, Bank Account Details.

scheme_name: Widow and Destitute Women Pension Scheme - Haryana
department_name: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs and BCs and Antyodaya
description_raw: Social welfare allowance for widows and destitute women in Haryana who are deprived of financial support and family sustenance.
benefits_raw: Monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month deposited directly into beneficiary bank account.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Domicile of Haryana; age 18 years or older; widowed, deserted, or destitute woman; total annual family income not exceeding ₹3,00,000 verified through Parivar Pehchan Patra.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Widows, Deserted women, Destitute female residents of Haryana
application_process_raw: Apply online through Antyodaya Saral portal (saralharyana.gov.in) or via local CSC / Antyodaya SARAL Kendra.
required_documents_raw: Death Certificate of Husband (for widows) or Desertion Order/Declaration, Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) ID, Aadhaar Card, Haryana Domicile Proof, Bank Account Passbook.

department_name: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description_raw: Price deficit compensation scheme aimed at risk mitigation for horticulture, vegetable, and bajra crop farmers by paying the difference between protected price and market wholesale price.
benefits_raw: Deficit compensation amount directly credited to farmer bank account based on difference between government base protected rate and actual mandi sale price.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Farmer cultivating notified crops in Haryana; land located in Haryana; mandatory pre-registration of crop sowing details on Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB) portal within prescribed seasonal window.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Farmers, Vegetable growers, Horticulture farmers in Haryana
application_process_raw: Register crop and sown acreage on Meri Fasal Mera Byora portal (fasal.haryana.gov.in) and complete sale in Haryana State Agricultural Marketing Board (HSAMB) mandis.
required_documents_raw: Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB) Registration Acknowledgement, Land Records (Jamabandi/Khasra Girdawari), Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Mandi J-Form sale receipt.

department_name: Department of Institutional Finance and Credit Control
description_raw: Comprehensive social security umbrella providing life insurance, accident insurance, and pension support to eligible poor and economically backward families in Haryana.
benefits_raw: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per family per year to cover premiums for PM-JJBY, PM-SBY, and pension schemes, with remaining balance deposited into beneficiary bank account.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Permanent resident family of Haryana; verified annual family income up to ₹1,80,000 in Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP); landholding not exceeding 5 acres (2 hectares).
target_beneficiaries_raw: Low-income families, Marginal farmers, Unorganized sector households in Haryana
application_process_raw: Apply online at Antyodaya Saral portal (saralharyana.gov.in) or mmpsy portal (cm-psy.haryana.gov.in) through Family ID (PPP).
required_documents_raw: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) Family ID, Aadhaar Cards of family members, Land Holding Document (if applicable), Bank Account Passbook, Self-Declaration.

scheme_name: Mera Pani Meri Virasat Scheme - Haryana
department_name: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description_raw: Crop diversification and water conservation incentive scheme designed to encourage farmers to replace water-intensive paddy crop with alternative dryland crops.
benefits_raw: Financial incentive of ₹7,000 per acre paid to farmers who switch from paddy to notified alternative crops like maize, pulses, cotton, fodder, or agro-forestry.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Farmer in Haryana having cultivated paddy in previous kharif season who diversifies land into notified non-paddy crops; registration on MFMB portal.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Farmers, Cultivators in underground water depleted blocks of Haryana
application_process_raw: Register acreage under alternative crops on Meri Fasal Mera Byora portal (fasal.haryana.gov.in) followed by physical ground verification by Agriculture Department.
required_documents_raw: Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB) registration, Aadhaar Card, Land Revenue Record (Farad/Jamabandi), Bank Account Details, Verification Certificate from Block Agriculture Officer.

description_raw: Universal cashless tertiary and secondary healthcare coverage expansion providing comprehensive medical insurance to low and middle-income families of Haryana.
benefits_raw: Cashless medical treatment and hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per annum across empaneled public and private hospitals.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Permanent resident of Haryana with Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP); families with verified annual income up to ₹1,80,000 (free) and ₹1,80,001 to ₹3,00,000 (with nominal annual contribution of ₹1,500).
target_beneficiaries_raw: Antyodaya families, Low-income households, BPL residents of Haryana
application_process_raw: Generate and download Chirayu Ayushman Card online through Chirayu Haryana portal or visit nearest CSC/empaneled hospital Ayushman Mitra desk.
required_documents_raw: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) Family ID, Aadhaar Card of family members, Mobile number linked with Aadhaar.

department_name: Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes Department
description_raw: Financial grant provided to disadvantaged, Scheduled Caste, and BPL families on the occasion of daughter marriage to reduce financial stress.
benefits_raw: Financial grant of up to ₹71,000 (₹66,000 before marriage + ₹5,000 on submission of marriage registration certificate) for eligible SC/BPL families.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Permanent resident of Haryana; bride minimum age 18 years and groom minimum age 21 years; verified BPL family or annual family income within prescribed limits; application within prescribed timeline.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Scheduled Caste families, BPL families, Destitute daughters, Divyang brides
application_process_raw: Apply online via Antyodaya Saral Portal (saralharyana.gov.in) before the marriage or within 6 months of marriage.
required_documents_raw: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) Family ID, Daughter and Groom Age Proof, Marriage Invitation Card / Marriage Certificate, BPL/Caste Certificate, Bank Account Passbook.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students - Haryana
description_raw: Government financial assistance for post-secondary education of Scheduled Caste students to support higher studies in colleges and universities.
benefits_raw: Full reimbursement of non-refundable tuition fees and standard monthly maintenance allowance for the duration of the approved academic course.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Haryana domicile; belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category; enrolled in recognized post-matric course (Class 11 to PhD); annual family income not exceeding ₹2,50,000.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Scheduled Caste students, College and University students from Haryana
application_process_raw: Apply online through Har-Chhatravritti Portal (harchhatravritti.highereduhry.ac.in) with institutional verification.
required_documents_raw: Scheduled Caste Certificate, Haryana Domicile Certificate, Income Certificate / PPP Family ID, Previous Year Marksheet, College Admission Fee Receipt, Bank Passbook.

description_raw: Capital subsidy program promoting green energy in agriculture by replacing diesel/electric pumps with standalone solar water pumping systems.
benefits_raw: 75% financial subsidy on total cost of standalone 3 HP to 10 HP solar water pumping systems (farmer pays only 25% beneficiary share).
eligibility_criteria_raw: Farmer having agricultural land in Haryana in their name; micro-irrigation system (drip/sprinkler) installed or committed; no existing electric tubewell connection on the applied land.
application_process_raw: Apply online on Saral Haryana portal (saralharyana.gov.in) during application window announced by HAREDA.
required_documents_raw: Land Jamabandi/Fard copy, Micro Irrigation certificate, Aadhaar Card, Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP), Self-declaration of no electric tubewell, Bank Account Details.

department_name: Department of Sports and Youth Affairs
description_raw: Premier sports excellence reward scheme conferring highest cash awards in India to medal winners and participants in international and national sports tournaments.
benefits_raw: Cash awards ranging from ₹50,000 for state/national medals up to ₹6 Crore for Olympic Gold, ₹4 Crore for Silver, and ₹2.5 Crore for Bronze.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Sportsperson who is a resident of Haryana or representing Haryana state in recognized National Games, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, or Olympic Games.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Athletes, Medal winners, Sportspersons of Haryana
application_process_raw: Submit online application via Sports Department portal (haryanasports.gov.in) through the respective District Sports Officer (DSO).
required_documents_raw: Sports Participation and Medal Certificates, Domicile Certificate of Haryana, Aadhaar Card, Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP), Bank Passbook, Passport Size Photos.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Antyodaya Parivar Utthan Yojana (HAPUY) - Haryana
description_raw: Flagship poverty alleviation mission identifying poorest families through PPP data and connecting them with packages of subsidies, loans, and skill training.
benefits_raw: Package of subsidized bank loans, capital subsidies (up to ₹50,000), self-employment assets (dairy, poultry, retail), and guaranteed skill training to raise family income above ₹1,80,000/year.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Permanent resident family of Haryana with Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP); verified annual family income below ₹1,00,000 per annum.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Poorest households, BPL families, Antyodaya citizens in Haryana
application_process_raw: Eligible families are invited to Antyodaya Utthan Melas organized in every block/district, or apply via Saral Haryana.
required_documents_raw: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) Family ID, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Skill/Project Choice Form.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Disabled Children - Haryana
department_name: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs and BCs and Antyodaya
description_raw: Special monthly financial maintenance assistance provided to parents and guardians of severely disabled children who are unable to attend school.
benefits_raw: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,150 per child paid directly to legal guardian bank account via DBT.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Resident of Haryana; child age between 0 and 18 years; certified permanent disability of 40% or more who cannot attend regular schools due to physical or mental limitations.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Differently-abled children (0-18 years), Guardians of children with severe disability
application_process_raw: Apply online on Antyodaya Saral portal (saralharyana.gov.in) or submit form at District Social Welfare Officer office.
required_documents_raw: Disability Certificate issued by Government Medical Board, Child Birth Certificate, Proof of Haryana Residence, Parivar Pehchan Patra, Guardian Bank Account Details.

scheme_name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojana - Haryana
department_name: Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes Department
description_raw: Merit scholarship encouraging academic excellence among Scheduled Caste, Backward Classes, and economically weaker students in rural and urban schools.
benefits_raw: One-time annual merit scholarship grant of ₹8,000 to ₹12,000 depending on class level (11th, 12th, or graduation entry).
eligibility_criteria_raw: Student of Haryana domicile; belongs to SC, BC-A, BC-B, or General BPL categories; passed matriculation or 10+2 with minimum benchmark marks (75% for urban, 70% for rural); family income within limit.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Meritorious SC/BC/BPL school students in Haryana
application_process_raw: Apply online through Saral Haryana portal (saralharyana.gov.in) with verified marksheets and school certificates.
required_documents_raw: Marksheet of qualifying examination (10th/12th), Caste Certificate, Haryana Domicile Certificate, Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) ID, Bank Account Passbook.

description_raw: Women economic empowerment initiative providing collateral-free subsidized institutional credit to female entrepreneurs to start or expand small enterprises.
benefits_raw: Term loans up to ₹3,00,000 provided by nationalized and scheduled banks with a 7% interest subvention for 3 years provided by Haryana Government.
eligibility_criteria_raw: Woman resident of Haryana; age between 18 and 60 years; verified annual family income up to ₹5,00,000 in Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP); viable business or enterprise project proposal.
target_beneficiaries_raw: Women entrepreneurs, Self-employed female residents of Haryana
application_process_raw: Apply online through Antyodaya Saral portal (saralharyana.gov.in) with project proposal for review by Haryana Women Development Corporation (HWDC).
required_documents_raw: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) Family ID, Project Business Profile / Quotation, Haryana Domicile Proof, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details.
